subject.title: fix(agent): harden execution and session boundaries

question: After the EOF-only resume defect is fixed, should this release intentionally require `--discover`, default newly discovered custom models to `supportsTools: false`, and disable agent service for ambiguous unqualified custom defaults?
rationale: These fail-safer choices are coherent and documented, but they deliberately change existing CLI and configuration behavior; tests cannot decide whether that upgrade contract is acceptable for current users.

options.title: Accept the safer contract after repair
options.body: Land the documented provider and ambiguity behavior after fixing the resume defect and validating both fresh and upgrade scenarios.

options.title: Preserve legacy defaults
options.body: Keep implicit discovery and existing ambiguous/default behavior unless users explicitly opt into stricter handling.

options.title: Split compatibility changes
options.body: Land execution/session boundary fixes now and move provider/default policy changes into a separately reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Accept the safer contract after repair
recommendation.body: Land the documented provider and ambiguity behavior after fixing the resume defect and validating both fresh and upgrade scenarios.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history and current implementation work identify steipete as the strongest available owner for the agent/session and provider behavior contract.
